arxiv-2106-06005.title: Simulating Calibration and Beam Systematics for future CMB space mission with TOAST package
arxiv-2106-06005.creator: Giuseppe Puglisi, Reijo Keskitalo, Ted Kisner, Julian D. Borrill
arxiv-2106-06005.description: Abstract We address in this work the instrumental systematic errors that can potentially affect the forthcoming and future Cosmic Microwave Background experiments aimed at observing its polarized emission. In particular, we focus on the systematics induced by the beam and calibration, which are considered the major sources of leakage from total intensity measurements to polarization.

arxiv-2302-14624.title: The 2022 NIST Language Recognition Evaluation
arxiv-2302-14624.creator: Yooyoung Lee 1 , Craig Greenberg 1 , Eliot Godard 1,∗ , Asad A. Butt 1,∗ , Elliot Singer 2 , Trang Nguyen 2 , Lisa Mason 3 , Douglas Reynolds 3
arxiv-2302-14624.description: Abstract In 2022, the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) conducted the latest Language Recognition Evaluation (LRE) in an ongoing series administered by NIST since 1996 to foster research in language recognition and to measure state-of-the-art technology. Similar to previous LREs, LRE22 focused on conversational telephone speech (CTS) and broadcast narrowband speech (BNBS) data.

arxiv-2303-01609.title: Theory of Topological Nernst and Thermoelectric Transport in Chiral Magnets
arxiv-2303-01609.creator: Zachariah Addison, Lauren Keyes, Mohit Randeria
arxiv-2303-01609.description: Abstract We calculate the thermoelectric transport of spin-orbit coupled conduction electrons in the presence of topological spin textures. We show, within a controlled, semiclassical approach that includes all phase space Berry curvatures, that the Nernst effect has two contributions in addition to the usual effect proportional to a magnetic field.

arxiv-2305-14425.title: Noninvertible anomalies in S ​ U ​ ( N ) × U ⁡ ( 1 ) SU(N)\times U(1) gauge theories
arxiv-2305-14425.creator: Mohamed M. Anber, Erich Poppitz
arxiv-2305-14425.description: Abstract We study 4 4 -dimensional S ​ U ​ ( N ) × U ⁡ ( 1 ) SU(N)\times U(1) gauge theories with a single massless Dirac fermion in the 2 2 -index symmetric/antisymmetric representations and show that they are endowed with a noninvertible 0 0 -form ℤ ~ 2 ​ ( N ± 2 ) χ \tilde{\mathbb{Z}}_{2(N\pm 2)}^{\chi}

arxiv-2306-00690.title: Quantum many-body scars in spin-1 Kitaev chain with uniaxial single-ion anisotropy
arxiv-2306-00690.creator: Wen-Yi Zhang, Ya-Nan Wang, Dongchang Liu, Jie Ren, Jia Li, Ning Wu, Andrzej M. Oleś, Wen-Long You
arxiv-2306-00690.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Wen-Yi Zhang, Ya-Nan Wang, Dongchang Liu, Jie Ren, Jia Li, Ning Wu, Andrzej M. Oleś, Wen-Long You. To establish a solid-state-based framework for the coexistence of quantum many-body scars and quantum criticality, we investigate the spin-1 Kitaev chain with uniaxial single-ion anisotropy (SIA). In the subspace with uniform ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} gauge fields, this model can be exactly mapped to the spin-1/2 effective detuned PXP Hamiltonian, where the SIA plays a role of the static detuning term.

arxiv-2401-12752.title: Detecting Population III Stars through Tidal Disruption Events in the Era of JWST and Roman
arxiv-2401-12752.creator: Rudrani Kar Chowdhury, Janet N. Y. Chang, Lixin Dai, Priyamvada Natarajan
arxiv-2401-12752.description: Abstract The first generation metal-free stars, referred to as population III (Pop III) stars, are believed to be the first objects to form out of the pristine gas in the very early Universe. Pop III stars have different structures from current generation of stars and are important for generating heavy elements and shaping subsequent star formation.

arxiv-2403-07600.title: Asymptotic ψ \psi -density of subsets of positive integers
arxiv-2403-07600.creator: J. Heittokangas and Z. Latreuch
arxiv-2403-07600.description: Abstract . The sizes of subsets of the natural numbers are typically quantified in terms of asymptotic (linear) and logarithmic densities. These concepts have been generalized to weighted w w -densities, where a specific weight function w w plays a key role.

arxiv-2412-01789.title: From ChebNet to ChebGibbsNet
arxiv-2412-01789.creator: Jie Zhang, Min-Te Sun
arxiv-2412-01789.description: Abstract Recent advancements in Spectral Graph Convolutional Networks (SpecGCNs) have led to state-of-the-art performance in various graph representation learning tasks. To exploit the potential of SpecGCNs, we analyze corresponding graph filters via polynomial interpolation, the cornerstone of graph signal processing.

arxiv-2505-07782.title: MLE-Dojo : Interactive Environments for Empowering LLM Agents in Machine Learning Engineering
arxiv-2505-07782.creator: Rushi Qiang , Yuchen Zhuang , Yinghao Li, Dingu Sagar V K, Rongzhi Zhang, Changhao Li, Ian Shu-Hei Wong, Sherry Yang §, Percy Liang §, Chao Zhang, Bo Dai
arxiv-2505-07782.description: Abstract We introduce MLE-Dojo , a Gym-style framework for systematically reinforcement learning, evaluating, and improving autonomous large language model (LLM) agents in iterative machine learning engineering (MLE) workflows. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily rely on static datasets or single-attempt evaluations, MLE-Dojo provides an interactive environment enabling agents to iteratively experiment, debug, and refine solutions through structured feedback loops.

arxiv-2507-13741.title: SamGoG: A Sampling-Based Graph-of-Graphs Framework for Imbalanced Graph Classification
arxiv-2507-13741.creator: Shangyou Wang, Zezhong Ding, Xike Xie
arxiv-2507-13741.description: Abstract Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have shown remarkable success in graph classification tasks by capturing both structural and feature-based representations. However, real-world graphs often exhibit two critical forms of imbalance: class imbalance and graph size imbalance. These imbalances can bias the learning process and degrade model performance.

arxiv-2602-08376.title: OJBKQ : O bjective- J oint B abai-Klein Q uantization
arxiv-2602-08376.creator: Xinyu Wang, Ziyu Zhao, Peng Lu, Xiao-Wen Chang
arxiv-2602-08376.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Xinyu Wang, Ziyu Zhao, Peng Lu, Xiao-Wen Chang. Post-training quantization (PTQ) is widely used to compress large language models without retraining. However, many existing weight-only methods rely on heuristic objectives and greedy rounding, thus leading to noticeable degradation under low-bit quantization In this work, we introduce OJBKQ (Objective-Joint Babai-Klein Quantization with K-Best Sampling), a layer-wise PTQ method that formulates weight quantization as a joint optimization problem over activations and weights.

It is also one of the significant causes of death and increased health care costs in modern intensive care...

pmc-10636476.title: Make a difference: implementation, quality and effectiveness of the WHO Surgical Safety Checklist—a narrative review
pmc-10636476.creator: Muriel Wyss, Michaela Kolbe, Bastian Grande
pmc-10636476.description: Background and ObjectiveThe positive effects of the WHO Surgery Safety Checklist (WHO SSC) have been demonstrated by a large amount of quantitative studies. With this review, the focus changes to the content of qualitative studies on WHO SSC to identify possible research gaps. In this way, gaps in the content of the execution of individual checklists can be closed.

pmc-10709716.title: Risk factors associated with preferential lateral lymph node metastasis in papillary thyroid carcinoma
pmc-10709716.creator: Liang Shao, Zhihong Wang, Wenwu Dong, Wei Sun, Hao Zhang
pmc-10709716.description: BackgroundLateral lymph node metastasis (LLNM) is common in patients with papillary thyroid cancer (PTC), usually occurring after central lymph node metastasis (CLNM). However, some patients experience LLNM without first developing CLNM. This study aimed to identify the risk factors for developing LLNM without CLNM.

pmc-11320859.title: A clearer vision: unveiling the importance of cycloplegic refraction and the pseudomyopia prevalence in Chinese preschoolers
pmc-11320859.creator: Peipei Liu, Bidan Zhu, Jing Fu, Yunyun Sun, Xiangxiang Liu, Lei Li, Shana Wang, Xi Qin
pmc-11320859.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to investigate the difference between cycloplegic and noncycloplegic refraction and evaluate the pseudomyopia prevalence in Chinese preschool children during the outbreak of COVID-19.MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted in the Tongzhou District of Beijing, China. Refractive error was measured under both noncycloplegic and cycloplegic conditions with autorefraction.

pmc-12361284.title: Pharmacological advances in HIV treatment: from ART to long-acting injectable therapies
pmc-12361284.creator: Krzysztof Łupina, Klaudia Nowak, Dominika Lorek, Adrian Nowak, Anna Romac, Ewelina Głowacka, Jakub Janczura
pmc-12361284.description: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) remains a global public health challenge, affecting millions worldwide despite significant advancements in antiretroviral therapy (ART). While ART has transformed HIV into a manageable chronic condition, long-term adherence, drug resistance, and access disparities continue to hinder treatment success.

pmc-12694773.title: Association of celiac disease with type 1 diabetes: A cross-sectional analysis in 2022
pmc-12694773.creator: Mahtab Ordooei, Roohollah Edalatkhah, Nasim Namiranian, Zahra khosravizade
pmc-12694773.description: Background:Type 1 diabetes mellitus (T1DM) and celiac disease (CD) are autoimmune disorders with a common genetic basis. Celiac disease often presents asymptomatically, leading to delayed diagnosis and potential complications like anemia and growth delays. This research investigates the prevalence of celiac disease in T1DM patients at the Yazd Diabetes Center in 2022.

pmc-13367364.title: Early Clinical Outcomes After the Mix-and-Match Approach of Trifocal and Non-Diffractive EDOF IOL
pmc-13367364.creator: Ayako Eno, Akiko Takai, Kyoko Fujita
pmc-13367364.description: PurposeTo evaluate early postoperative visual performance following cataract surgery using the mix-and-match approach with Clareon PanOptix diffractive trifocal and Clareon Vivity non-diffractive extended depth of focus (EDOF) intraocular lenses (IOLs).Patients and MethodsThis single-center, retrospective study was conducted between April 2024 and April 2025 and included 27 patients (54 eyes).

pmc-13434501.title: Application of acceptability in dietary optimisation models: a systematic review
pmc-13434501.creator: Cathrine Baungaard, Magaly Aceves-Martins, Graham Horgan, David Little, Jonathan Hillier, Baukje de Roos
pmc-13434501.description: Objective:Diet optimisation models have been developed to deal with the complexities of designing a sustainable diet. Diet acceptability is one aspect of a sustainable diet that has had limited integration into these models. This systematic review summarises and critically assesses the available literature regarding diet acceptability in optimisation studies.

pmc-13586590.title: Assessment of patients’ attitudes and actions toward Patient Information Leaflets in Jordan: A cross-sectional study
pmc-13586590.creator: Qusai Al-Anasweh, Afnan Rababa, Moutaz Amayrh, Osama Alrjoob, Laith Ashour, Ala’ Al-Doaikat, Nada Freihat, Hala Al-Miqdadi, Mohammad Al Khreisha, Malak Al-Rabe’e, Al-Mo’tasem Bellah Al-Rahamneh, Lama Al-Mehaisen
pmc-13586590.description: ObjectivesThis study evaluated patients’ attitudes and behaviors toward patient information leaflets (PILs) in Jordan. In detail, we highlighted patients’ willingness to use PILs and determined predictors of PIL reading in the Jordanian population.MethodsTo assess patients’ attitudes and actions toward PILs, we conducted a cross-sectional study targeting patients in the 3 Jordanian regions (north, middle, and south).

pmc-13689198.title: Synovial oxidative stress biomarkers are not associated with radiological severity in knee osteoarthritis: a prospective cross-sectional study
pmc-13689198.creator: Hakan Yolaçan, Hüseyin Erdal, Serkan Güler
pmc-13689198.description: ObjectiveThis prospectively enrolled cross-sectional study aimed to evaluate the relationship between synovial fluid oxidative stress parameters and radiographic severity in patients with knee osteoarthritis and to determine whether these biomarkers reflect radiographic stage.MethodsA total of 98 patients aged 50 years and older with primary knee osteoarthritis were prospectively enrolled in this cross-sectional study.
